scope: Molecular-solubility benchmark, split audit and frozen prediction export
limits: Targeted verification of sources already used plus directly relevant official documentation; not a new systematic search.
Access levels distinguish full-text sections, abstracts and metadata. Historical search logs are preserved.
A source supports only the claims listed; project-specific results come from local data/code and are not attributed to literature.

references.title: ESOL: estimating aqueous solubility directly from molecular structure
supported_claims: Historical structure-based solubility model and 2,874-value development sample.
limitations: Abstract/citation only; the released support table and processed subset are verified separately.
This project does not reproduce the original fitted equation.

references.title: ESOL: Estimating Aqueous Solubility Directly from Molecular Structure — supporting data
supported_claims: Original supporting file identity and CC BY-NC 4.0 license.
limitations: The metadata/license record is not evidence that all assays share conditions.
No inference is made about why 16 supporting-table rows are missing from the processed benchmark.

references.title: Will we ever be able to accurately predict solubility?
supported_claims: Solubility endpoint definitions, assay context, overlapping sources and external evaluation affect interpretation.
limitations: Full PMC body retrieved in two parts; relevant measurement and data-evaluation sections inspected.
Its effect sizes and model rankings are not transferred.

references.title: Boosting the predictive performance with aqueous solubility dataset curation
supported_claims: Repeated records and data curation affect a specific multi-dataset solubility workflow.
limitations: Full PMC body retrieved in two parts; its curation rules, filtering choices and improvements are not adopted.
corrections: Replaced incomplete five-name author list with first author et al.; PubMed lists eight authors.

references.title: The properties of known drugs. 1. Molecular frameworks
supported_claims: Conceptual basis of ring/linker molecular frameworks.
limitations: Abstract only. Exact executable nonchiral definition verified in pinned RDKit source; not every framework variant in the paper is implemented.

references.title: MoleculeNet: a benchmark for molecular machine learning
supported_claims: Molecular benchmark interpretation depends on data, splits, representations, models and metrics.
limitations: Full PMC body retrieved in two parts; no published score is treated as comparable to this custom protocol.

references.title: UMAP-based clustering split for rigorous evaluation of AI models for virtual screening on cancer cell lines
supported_claims: Different scaffold labels can retain structural similarity; evaluation depends on split and metric choices.
limitations: Full PMC body retrieved in two parts. Its endpoint is cell-line virtual screening, not solubility; no effect size or preferred method is transferred.

references.title: Delaney dataset loader
supported_claims: Official processed-data URL, measured-solubility target name and 1,128-record task.
limitations: Its code license does not determine the dataset license; current loader code is not executed here.

references.title: MurckoScaffold.py
supported_claims: GetScaffoldForMol and MurckoScaffoldSmiles with includeChirality=False define the grouping used.
MakeScaffoldGeneric is a separate function and is not called.
limitations: Current web API is RDKit 2026.09.1; the versioned source, not current API branding, supports runtime 2025.9.1 semantics.

references.title: rdkit.Chem.Scaffolds.MurckoScaffold
supported_claims: Public API descriptions distinguish ordinary and generic scaffolds.
limitations: Not documentation of the pinned 2025.9.1 runtime; pinned source checked separately.

references.title: GroupKFold
supported_claims: Supplied groups do not overlap across validation folds.
limitations: The software cannot determine whether the chosen groups capture all scientific dependencies.

references.title: GroupShuffleSplit
supported_claims: The test-size fraction applies to groups rather than individual samples.
limitations: Exact row proportion depends on group sizes.

references.title: Common pitfalls and recommended practices
supported_claims: Fit preprocessing and select models on training data; apply learned transformations to held-out data.
limitations: Does not enforce collaborator behavior or establish external validation.

references.title: mean_squared_error
supported_claims: Unweighted paired squared-error arithmetic underlying RMSE.

references.title: r2_score
supported_claims: R-squared may be negative; constant targets yield undefined/nonfinite values before optional finite replacements.
limitations: This repository deliberately represents undefined constant-target R-squared as null rather than using finite replacements.

follow_up_reviews.scope: Targeted maintenance and scientific-language recheck; earlier source-by-source dates and historical search logs retained.

source_checks.checked: Current PubMed abstract and bibliographic metadata; original ESOL model distinct from this descriptor benchmark.
ACS Figshare API: supporting-data DOI, original file identity and CC BY-NC 4.0 verified.
Current PubMed abstract on measurement sources, curation and prospective reliability; no performance values transferred.
Version 1.8 group-separation semantics checked against implemented inner validation.

limits: This follow-up is not a new systematic literature search or comprehensive supplementary-material appraisal.
Local numerical reproduction verifies calculations, not biological generalization.
